scenarios.null: true frozen model (size of the gate)
scenarios.p12: data Omori exponent p = 1.2 (frozen 1.0001), same n
scenarios.alpha_half: data productivity exponent alpha / 2, same n
scenarios.cluster_plus: stronger clustering than the model: data K scaled to branching ratio n = 0.95
scenarios.cluster_plus_same_rate: stronger clustering (n = 0.95) at the model's annual count: background lowered
scenarios.swarm_ctrl: 30 extra events within 7 days in the control region (2026)
scenarios.swarm_glac: 30 extra events within 7 days in the glacier region (2026)
scenarios.signal_glac: the sought signal: glacier-region background x 1.5 in 2026, model otherwise true
